November 1, 2026


## It takes a team to operate the best ships.


We take immense pride in our ships, dedicating our time, energy, and enthusiasm to ensure they operate safely and efficiently. Achieving this standard requires shore and sea to come together, leveraging our collective wisdom and energy toward a common goal.


From our vessels to our offices, we combine our strengths to reinforce our core #TeekaySPIRIT value of Sustainability. True operational excellence is built on shared responsibility and teamwork.


By uniting our shore-side expertise with our onboard crews, we maintain the highest standards of safety and sustainability across our entire fleet.
